raw: Newly-elected members of the Politburo Standing Committee and alternate members as well as provincial and ministerial-level leading cadres have completed their study course on implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.
February 11, 2023 at 1:07 PM [Source: Xinhua News Agency] [Editor: Li Sufeng] Font size: 【large | medium | small】

src: 新华社北京2月10日电 新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班10日下午在中央党校（国家行政学院）结业，中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记蔡奇出席结业式并作总结讲话。
raw: Xinhua News Agency reported that the Central Committee’s new members and candidates for membership in the Politburo Standing Committee as well as provincial and ministerial-level leading cadres who have joined the Communist Party of China (CPC) at the 20th National Congress of the CPC were gathered to attend a seminar on learning and implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress. The seminar concluded today afternoon at the Central Party School (National Academy of Governance), where General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Zhang Jie, attended the closing ceremony and delivered a speech summarizing the seminar.

src: 他表示，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话精神，更加坚定拥护“两个确立”、坚决做到“两个维护”，增强本领、真抓实干，扎实推进中国式现代化各项工作，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家、全面推进中华民族伟大复兴中创造经得起历史、实践和人民检验的业绩。
raw: He said that he would thoroughly study and implement the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar training class, with greater determination to uphold the “two establishments” and resolutely achieve the “two upholds,” strengthen his abilities and work hard to advance all tasks related to China’s modernization in accordance with the requirements of socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era, and create achievements worthy of historical, practical, and people's judgment in fully building a modern socialist country and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 研讨班期间，全体学员以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，认真学习党的二十大精神和习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话，联系实际深入研讨交流，深化了对中国式现代化一系列重大理论和实践问题的认识，增强了在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴的信心和决心，增强了履职尽责、做好工作、确保新时代新征程良好开局的责任感和使命感。
raw: During the seminar period, all participants studied and deeply discussed with practical examples the important speeches of President Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar as well as the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC). This has deepened their understanding of a series of major theoretical and practical issues related to China’s modernization in its own way, enhanced their confidence and determination to advance China’s modernization under the leadership of the Central Committee led by Comrade Xi Jinping, strengthened their sense of responsibility and mission for fulfilling duties and responsibilities, and ensuring a good start in the new era and new journey.

src: 结业式上，研讨班10名代表发言，汇报交流了学习收获。
raw: At the graduation ceremony, representatives from Class 10 made speeches to report and exchange their learning experiences.

src: 蔡奇表示，学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神，既是当前和今后一个时期的首要政治任务，也是一项长期战略任务，要按照“全面学习、全面把握、全面落实”的要求，推动学习贯彻工作不断往深里走、往实里走、往心里走。
raw: Chai Qi stated that learning and implementing the thought of socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era under Xi Jinping’s leadership is both an urgent political task for the present and in the future as well, and should be carried out according to the requirements of “comprehensive study, comprehensive grasp, and comprehensive implementation.” It is necessary to push forward the work on learning and implementing it further down deep, more solidly, and deeper into people's hearts.

src: 要更加深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义，坚决维护习近平总书记的核心地位、维护党中央权威和集中统一领导，不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，始终在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致。
raw: To more deeply understand the decisive significance of “the two establishments,” we must resolutely uphold the core position of Xi Jinping and the authority of the Central Committee with Comrade Xi at its heart, as well as the centralized and unified leadership of the Party. We should continuously enhance our political judgment, political insight, and political execution, ensuring that we always maintain high consistency in thought, politics, and action with the Central Committee led by Comrade Xi.

src: 要努力掌握好马克思主义理论这一看家本领，自觉用党的创新理论武装头脑、指导实践、推动工作，在深学、细悟、笃行上下功夫，真正学出坚定信念、学出绝对忠诚、学出使命担当。
raw: To diligently master and apply Marxist theory as one’s forte, consciously arm oneself with the Party’s innovative theories to guide one’s thoughts, practice, and work, and strive to achieve deep study, meticulous understanding, and firm implementation in these areas; truly learn to acquire unwavering belief, absolute loyalty, and mission commitment.

src: 要以奋发有为的精神状态贯彻落实好党的二十大各项决策部署，扎实推进中国式现代化，撸起袖子加油干，扑下身子当好“施工队长”，一步一个脚印把蓝图变为现实。
raw: To earnestly implement all decisions and deployments of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with an enterprising spirit, advance the Chinese-style modernization, roll up our sleeves to work hard, get down to business as a good “construction supervisor”, step by step turn the blueprint into reality.

src: 要牢记全面从严治党永远在路上、党的自我革命永远在路上，压紧压实全面从严治党政治责任，以党的政治建设为统领，深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程。
raw: It is imperative to remember that comprehensive and strict governance of the Party must be pursued at all times, and self-revolution within the Party must also continue forever. The political responsibility for comprehensive and strict governance of the Party should be pressed firmly, with party political construction serving as the overarching principle, and efforts should be made to advance the new great project of Party building in the new era.

src: 要增强推动高质量发展本领、服务群众本领、防范化解风险本领，大兴调查研究之风，坚决防止和克服形式主义、官僚主义。
raw: To enhance skills in promoting high-quality development, serving the people, and managing risks, we must vigorously promote research work, resolutely prevent and correct formalism and bureaucracy.

src: 石泰峰、李干杰、李书磊、陈文清、刘金国、王小洪出席结业式，陈希主持结业式。
raw: Zhi Tai Feng, Li Ganjie, Li Shulei, Chen Wenqing, Liu JinGuo, Wang Xiaohong attended the graduation ceremony and Chen Xi presided over it.

src: 东德最后一位共产党总理今去世
raw: East Germany's last Communist Prime Minister is dead.

src: 东德共产党的继任者在该党在一份声明中报告，“昨晚，汉斯·莫德罗 (Hans Modrow) 离开了我们，享年 95 岁。
raw: The successors of the East German Communist Party reported in their statement that “last night Hans Modrow [who] left us at the age of 95.”

src: 因此，我们的党失去了一位重要领导人。
raw: Therefore, our party lost an important leader.
English: "Translation requested."

src: 1989 年 11 月 13 日，在将东柏林和西柏林分开 28 年的柏林墙打开四天后，莫德罗曾表示他将帮助把东德变成一个民主国家。
raw: On November 13, 1989, four days after the Berlin Wall was opened to reunite East and West Berlin, Modrow had said he would help turn East Germany into a democratic state.

src: 当时，由于东德各地的抗议者要求民主和自由，共产党领导人被迫下台。
raw: At that time, because of protests in East Germany demanding democracy and freedom, communist leaders were forced to resign.

src: 戈尔巴乔夫 (Mikhail Gorbachev) 在苏联上台后曾要求在苏联主导的东欧也进行变革。
raw: Gorbachev had demanded reforms in Eastern Europe as well after coming to power in the Soviet Union.

src: 1990 年 3 月，莫德罗宣布德意志民主共和国 (GDR) 的第一次也是唯一一次自由选举。
raw: On March 1990, Modrow announced the first and only free election of the German Democratic Republic (GDR).

src: 选举结果导致他不再担任总理。
raw: The election result led him to resign as Prime Minister.

src: 尽管莫德罗进行了改革，但反对者指责他试图推迟 1990 年 10 月发生的政治变革和统一。
raw: Even though Modrego implemented reforms, opponents accused him of trying to postpone the political and constitutional changes that occurred in October 1990.

src: 他还因试图重塑而不是废除秘密警察而受到批评。
raw: He is criticized for attempting to reinvent rather than abolish secret police.

src: 1993 年，莫德罗在 1989 年 5 月的市政选举中被判选举舞弊罪名成立，但并未入狱。
raw: In 1993, Modrego was found guilty of electoral fraud in May 1989 but not imprisoned.

src: 有称这些指控是出于政治动机。
raw: Some have charged that these charges were motivated by political considerations.

src: 1990 年至 1994 年，莫德罗继续在德国议会任职，并于 1999 年至 2004 年担任欧洲议会议员。
raw: From 1990 to 1994, Modrow continued his parliamentary career in Germany and served as an MEP from 1999 to 2004.

src: 莫德罗将自己视为一名改革者，并希望从内部改变共产党。
raw: Morel sees himself as an innovator and hopes to change the Communist Party from within.

src: 1999 年，他告诉路透社，他不希望旧东德回归，但表示应该承认东德的成就。
raw: In 1999, he told Reuters that he did not want to see East Germany return, but said it should be acknowledged for its achievements.

src: 莫德罗于 1928 年出生在当时的德国小镇 Jasenitz（现为波兰的 Jasienica），并接受过机械师培训。
raw: Maderlo was born in the German village of Jasenitz (now part of Poland) and received training as an electrician.

src: 第二次世界大战期间，他担任青年消防队排长，并在冲突快结束时成为纳粹民兵组织 Volkssturm 的一员，该组织征召 16 至 60 岁的男子参加最后的战争挣扎。
raw: During World War II, he served as an officer of the Young Firemen’s Battalion and became a member of the Volkssturm, a militia organization that conscripted men aged 16 to 60 for the final struggle of the war.

src: 17 岁时，莫德罗被苏联军队俘虏，作为战俘被带到苏联，在那里他参加了反法西斯课程，并成为一名坚定的共产党员。
raw: At age seventeen, Modro was captured by Soviet troops and taken prisoner to the USSR where he participated in anti-fascist courses and became a committed communist.

src: 1949 年，即东德成立的那一年，他回国后找到了一份机械师的工作，并继续学习社会科学和经济学，并获得了博士学位。
raw: In 1949, when East Germany was founded, he found a job as an auto mechanic and continued his studies in social sciences and economics, eventually earning a PhD.

src: 莫德罗是自由德国青年运动的一名工作人员，几乎所有东德年轻人都加入了该运动，并在 1973 年至 1989 年期间通过执政的社会统一党 (SED) 晋升为德累斯顿地区党的主席。
raw: Mördler was an organizer of the Free German Youth movement and almost all young people in East Germany joined it between 1973 and 1989 through the Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD), which later became the Christian Democratic Union (CDU).

src: 他还在东德任职议会超过 30 年。
raw: He was still serving in the East German parliament for more than thirty years.

src: 1990 年莫德罗成为东德事实上的领导人，担任最高国家职务。
raw: In 1990, Modrow became de facto leader of East Germany and held the highest office in the country.

src: 越通社河内——越通社特派记者报道，越南政府总理范明政和夫妇对新加坡和文莱进行正式访问已圆满成功，并取得了全面、务实且具体的成果。
raw: VNA Hanoi – VNA correspondent for Vietnam’s Prime Minister Nguyen Xuan Phuc and his wife have successfully completed their official visit to Singapore and Brunei, achieving comprehensive, practical, and specific results.

src: 在出访新加坡和文莱的三天之内，范明政总理共参加了30多项不同的活动。
raw: Von Moltke attended 30 different events in three days on state visits to Singapore and Brunei.

src: 所取得的成效为促进越新两国战略伙伴关系和越文全面伙伴关系不断朝着更深、更广和有效的方向发展注入了新的动力。
raw: The gains have injected new impetus to deepen and broaden the strategic partnership between the two countries and the comprehensive partnership in Vietnamese language.

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理继续重申越南党和国家的对外路线，即独立自主，多元化，多变化，愿做所有国家的好朋友和可靠伙伴，以及国际社会的负责任成员。
raw: During his visit to both countries, Pham Minh Chinh reiterated Vietnam’s foreign policy of independence, diversification, and dynamism, willing to be good friends and reliable partners for all nations as well as responsible members of the international community.

src: 加强与新加坡和文莱的关系是各自国家的需求，致力于增进各自国家人民的福祉，致力于地区和世界的和平、稳定和发展。
raw: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is in each country’s interest to promote the welfare of its people and contribute to regional and global peace, stability, and development.

src: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
raw: At each meeting and negotiation session, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has agreed with leaders of Singapore and Brunei to strengthen political trust with Vietnam through high-level visits, effective implementation of bilateral cooperation mechanisms and important agreements in various ways.

src: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
raw: Many cooperation documents were signed during this visit.

src: 其中，与新加坡签署的《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》和与文莱签署的《2023-2027年阶段加强越文全面伙伴关系的行动计划》是两大亮点。
raw: Among these, two major highlights include the Memorandum of Understanding on Green and Digital Economy Partnership signed with Singapore and the Action Plan for Strengthening Comprehensive Partnership between Vietnam and Brunei Darussalam for the 2023-2027 Period.

src: 越南与新加坡签署《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》。
raw: Vietnam and Singapore Sign Green and Digital Economy Partnership Memorandum of Understanding.

src: 图自越通社
raw: Image from VNA.

src: 在会见企业领导，座谈会或出席经济论坛期间，范明政总理强调越南欢迎并为新加坡和文莱企业在越南的数字化转型、绿色能源、高科技、创新创意等领域扩大投资范围创造便利条件。
raw: Vingroup President Nguyen Phu Trong stressed during meetings with business leaders, seminars or at economic forums that Vietnam is open to and ready to create favorable conditions for Singaporean and Bruneian companies to expand their investments in digital transformation, green energy, high-tech, innovation and creativity sectors in the country.

src: 此次访问不仅有助于深化越南与新加坡和文莱在政治、外交、经济、安全、国防、教育培训、油气、旅游、民间交流等各个传统领域上的合作关系，而且还为各国在数字经济、绿色经济、能源转型、创新创意、智慧城市、可持续发展等新的潜在领域创造合作框架。
raw: This visit will deepen Vietnam’s cooperation with Singapore and Brunei in traditional areas such as politics, diplomacy, economy, security, defense, education, oil and gas, tourism, people-to-people exchanges, among others; it also creates new frameworks for cooperation in emerging fields like digital economy, green economy, energy transition, innovation and creativity, smart cities, sustainable development, etc.

src: 文莱国王哈桑纳尔博尔基亚与范明政总理准备进入双边座谈会。
raw: King Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah of Brunei and Premier Wen Jiabao are preparing to enter a bilateral meeting.

src: 图自越通社
raw: Image from VNA.

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理都安排时间走访和聆听旅居当地越南人社群的心思和愿望。
raw: During his visits to both countries, Pham Minh Chinh’s Prime Minister has made time to visit and listen to the thoughts and aspirations of Vietnamese expatriates living there.

src: 在两国领导人会见中，范明政总理都建议两国当局多关注，并为当地越南人社群得到公平的对待，有机会为当地社会贡献力量并培育两国关系等创造有利条件。
raw: In meetings with their counterparts, Pham Minh Chinh called on both governments to pay more attention and create favorable conditions for fair treatment of local Vietnamese communities in both countries, so that they can contribute to society and nurture bilateral relations.

src: 该建议都得到了两国领导人的同意和支持。
raw: The proposal has been agreed to and supported by both leaders of the two countries.

src: 特别的是，范明政总理还与两国领导人分享有关一个团结、和平、稳定和繁荣的东盟共同体的渴望；一致同意将与东盟国家保持团结协作并提升东盟在地区和国际形势复杂多变背景下的中心作用。
raw: In particular, Vice President Fang Mingzheng also shared with the leaders of both countries his desire for an ASEAN Community that is united, peaceful, stable and prosperous; they agreed to maintain unity and cooperation with ASEAN member states while enhancing their role as a regional and international leader in the complex and ever-changing geopolitical environment.

src: 凭借所取得的重要成果，范明政总理对新加坡和文莱的正式访问之旅为有效落实越共十三大以加强与东盟邻国的关系为优先的对外路线，有效实施越共中央政治局关于新形势下越南侨务工作的第12号结论（12-KL/TW ），并发挥全民族团结力量等作出积极贡献。
raw: With its important achievements, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh made an official visit to Singapore and Brunei to effectively implement the Party’s Third Congress’ priority of strengthening relations with ASEAN neighbors through effective implementation of the 12th Conclusion (12-KL/TW) of the Central Committee Political Bureau on Vietnamese Foreign Affairs in the new situation, as well as making positive contributions to mobilizing the strength of the entire nation.
(Complete)

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 警情通告：司警局呼吁市民提防假冒电讯公司诈骗短讯
raw: NEWS GOV-MO: WARNING: POLICE DEPARTMENT CALLS FOR CITIZENS TO BE ON TROTTLE WITH HOAX TELECOM COMPANY FRAUD SMS

src: 近日司警局接获多宗电信诈骗案，不法分子假冒本澳电讯公司向事主发送附有网站连结的诈骗短信，以积分到期须尽快换领奖赏为饵，诱骗事主登入虚假网站进行兑换。
raw: Recently, the Police Bureau received multiple reports of telecommunications fraud cases where criminals impersonated local telecom companies and sent fraudulent SMSs containing links to fake websites, promising rewards for exchanging points that were about to expire.

src: 事主按指示输入信用卡资料及验证码，随即收到金融机构通知信用卡出现不明消费记录，怀疑信用卡资料经上述网站被盗取。
raw: The matter was handled in accordance with instructions to input credit card details and verification code; subsequently, an institution notified of unexplained charges on the credit card, suspecting that the credit card information had been stolen from the aforementioned website.

src: 经查，证实相关电讯公司并无发出上述短讯。
raw: Upon investigation, it was confirmed that the relevant telecommunications companies did not send out the aforementioned messages.

src: 司警局呼吁市民，如接获类似手机短讯须提高警惕，切勿登入短讯所载网站连结或提供任何个人资料；若被要求提供信用卡资料、帐户交易密码、交易验证码，更要加倍谨慎，防止信用卡被盗刷。
raw: The Police Bureau urges citizens to be vigilant if they receive similar SMS and not to log onto websites linked in the message or provide any personal information; even more so when asked for credit card details, account transaction passwords, or transaction verification codes, as this could lead to credit card theft.

src: 防骗提示：
raw: Fraud Alert:

src: 1. 多关注网络安全资讯，提高个人防范意识；
raw: 1. Pay more attention to cybersecurity news and enhance personal awareness of prevention.

src: 2. 切勿随便登入来历不明的网站并在网站内登记个人及信用卡资料，以防遭人盗用；
raw: Do not casually log onto unknown websites and register your personal and credit card information there to prevent identity theft;

src: 3. 警惕假冒网站及钓鱼网站，时刻留意网站网址是否与官方网站完全相符；
raw: Be wary of fake and phishing websites, always checking if the website's URL matches that of the official site exactly.

src: 4. 为手机、移动装置或电脑安装防毒软件，并定期更新；
raw: 4. Install antivirus software on phones, mobile devices, or computers and update it regularly;

src: 5. 怀疑遇到诈骗或其他犯罪时，应立即致电司警局防诈骗查询热线8800 7777或报案热线993求助。
raw: If you suspect that you have been a victim of fraud or any other crime, please contact the Police Commissioner's Fraud Reporting Hotline at 8800 7777 or the Crime Report Line at 993 for assistance immediately.

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争论，欧盟官员：接收过程步步瓶颈-中新网
raw: EU summit over refugee policy debate; EU officials say process is bogged down

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争吵不休，欧盟官员：接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈
raw: EU summit overrefugee policy deadlock; EU officials say bottleneck at every step of admission process

src: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者 牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
raw: 【Global Times Brussels Correspondent Ni Ruifei】According to Reuters on February 10th, during the latest EU summit, Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said that EU leaders agreed to introduce stricter policies on illegal immigration in order to make it easier to deport them.

src: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
raw: It is reported that this move by the EU is an answer to growing concerns in Europe about illegal immigration, and now the core issue of the EU is that few people can be deported.

src: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
raw: According to summit documents, EU leaders called on the Commission “to mobilize large amounts of EU funding immediately” for infrastructure and surveillance measures aimed at strengthening external borders.

src: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
raw: Yet, there is bitter disagreement between the EU and its member states over payment of fence-related costs.

src: 冯德莱恩一再表示，欧盟资金不会支付相关费用。
raw: Frauenfeld repeatedly stated that EU funds would not cover related costs.

src: 但一些成员国的外交官员称，如果欧盟能分担外部边界沿线安装摄像头、瞭望塔和其他基础设施的部分，这将给各国腾出国家预算从而加快建设进程。
raw: But some EU member states’ diplomats say that if the Union were to share responsibility for installing cameras and observation posts along its external borders, this would free up national budgets so as to speed up construction.

src: 欧洲Euractiv网站称，欧盟官员承认，难民接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈，有限的接收能力和成员国不堪重负的移民当局无法阻止难民在欧盟各国提交“无数”庇护申请，欧盟的难民接收系统处于近乎“永久性的危机”中。
raw: The European Union’s Euractiv website reports that EU officials acknowledge that there are bottlenecks at every stage of the refugee reception process and that the limited capacity to receive refugees and member states’ overwhelmed immigration authorities cannot prevent refugees from submitting “numerous” asylum applications in all EU countries, putting the EU’s refugee reception system on an almost permanent crisis footing.

src: 据欧盟委员会估计，欧盟的申根国家去年收到超92万份庇护申请，比前一年增加近半。
raw: The European Commission estimates that in 2017, EU Schengen countries received over 920,000 asylum applications, up nearly half from the previous year.

src: 与此同时，欧盟去年记录到超 33万次非法入境。
raw: At the same time, the EU recorded over 330,000 illegal entries last year.

src: 在该背景下，此次峰会还就一项“原则”达成协议，即欧盟国家可根据另一个成员国的法院判决将非法移民遣返回国。
raw: In this context, the summit also reached an agreement on a “principle,” namely that EU member states can deport illegal immigrants to their home countries if they are ordered to do so by another member state’s court.

src: 此外，报道称，欧盟领导人还同意“增加对安全国家概念的使用”，这将为欧盟制定共同清单开辟道路。
raw: Moreover, it is reported that EU leaders also agreed to “increase the use of the concept of ‘safe states’,” which will pave the way for the EU to develop a common list.

src: (来源：环球时报 作者：牛瑞飞)
raw: (Source: Global Times; Author: Liu Ruifei)

src: 国民党副主席夏立言访中传达宋涛语：九二共识下欢迎绿营访陆
raw: Hsia Liuyan, vice chairman of the Kuomintang, conveyed Song Tao’s message that the 1992 Consensus is welcome for Green camp visits to China.

src: 台湾中国国民党副主席夏立言今次访中先后会见中国国台办主任宋涛与中共中央政治局常委王沪宁。
raw: Taiwan China Nationalist Party Vice Chairman Xia Liuyan met with both the State Councilor and Premier of the People's Republic of China, Wang Linqing, and the Director-General of the Office of the Central People’s Government in the Taiwan Area, Song Tao, on separate occasions this time.

src: 国民党官方机构国政基金会资深顾问赵春山昨天晚上接受台湾中央社采访，积极评价宋涛对夏立言所说，只要认同“九二共识”与反台独，中国欢迎绿营人士到访大陆。
raw: Senior Advisor Zhao Chunshan of the Nationalist Party’s official organization, the Council for Political and Economic Affairs, yesterday evening accepted an interview with Taiwan’s Central News Agency and actively praised Song Tao’s comments on Xia Liuyan that as long as one agrees to “the 92 Consensus” and anti-Taiwanese independence, China welcomes Green camp figures to visit mainland China.

src: 国民党方面评价认为是新鲜事物。
raw: The Nationalist Party's assessment is that it is newsworthy.

src: 夏立言稍早会见宋涛当日新闻没有提及此说法。
raw: Xia Liyan met with Song Tao earlier that day, but the news did not mention this claim.

src: 台湾执政的民进党连日澄清拒绝接受“九二共识”。
raw: The ruling Democratic Progressive Party in Taiwan has been clarifying its refusal to accept the “92 Consensus.”

src: 据中央社今天称，国民党副主席夏立言率团访陆，在北京期间，分别会见中共中央政治局常委王沪宁、新任国台办主任宋涛，与北京市委书记尹力。
raw: The Central News Agency reported today that Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, Xia Liuyan, led an delegation to visit China, where he met with Standing Committee member of the CPC Politburo Wang Lianying and newly appointed Director-General of the Nationalist Affairs Office Song Tao in Beijing, as well as Mayor of Beijing Yin Li.

src: 夏立言与宋涛会面谈到国共的政治基础是“九二共识”与反台独，国民党国政基金会资深顾问赵春山则在会中表示，国民党的“九二共识”是原汁原味的“九二共识”。
raw: Xia Liyan met with Song Tao to discuss the political foundation of the two parties being “the 92 Consensus” and anti-Taiwan independence. Former senior advisor of the Kuomintang’s National Political Council, Zhao Chunshan, made this statement during the meeting.

src: 赵春山分析，这与前几次参与的会议感受不同。
raw: Zhao Chunshan notes that this is different from his previous experiences at meetings.

src: 近期与大陆学界视讯座谈，以及这次的座谈，没有听到涉台学者讲武统与“反分裂法”，取而代之的是恢复交流与对话。
raw: Recent video conferences with mainland academic circles have not heard scholars advocating for unification or “Anti-Secession Law,” but rather restoring exchanges and dialogue.

src: 赵春山指出，两岸兵凶战危，中国大陆盼能透过国民党转达改善关系的意向。
raw: Chao Chunshan noted that cross-strait military confrontation and war is imminent, and China hopes to convey through the Kuomintang an intention to improve relations.

src: 因为民共之间没有互信，对方仍愿做好对台湾人工作，代表不希望两岸关系搞坏。
raw: Because there is no trust between people of one’s own kind, he still wishes to do well for the Taiwanese people and represents that he does not want the two sides’ relations to be damaged.

src: 据赵春山也说，王沪宁也亲自下指示向宋涛讲“他们（台湾农渔民）提的要求，你们一定要落实”，若无法通盘解决，也要采个案处理。
raw: Xiao Chunshan also says that Wang Linqing personally instructed Song Tao to tell Foyu (Taiwan’s agricultural and fishermen) “that their demands must be implemented.” If it cannot be resolved in its entirety, individual cases should be handled instead.

src: 该报道没有提及国民党人访大陆是否当面提及中国军机军舰每日扰台，台湾少数县市的农渔问题，以及中央社记者采访是否提问此类问题。
raw: The report does not mention whether Nationalist Party officials visited mainland China to discuss their daily harassment of Taiwan by military aircraft and warships, or the problems in some counties and cities on Taiwan’s agricultural and fishing sectors, or if Central News Agency reporters asked such questions.

src: 阿拉斯加上空被击落的 “物体”究竟是什么？
raw: What was "the object" that crashed in the airspace above阿拉斯加?

src: 扑朔迷离，猜测纷纷
raw: Confusing and contradictory, speculation rife.

src: 美国军方周五（2月10日）下午再次动用美国最先进的隐身喷气战机F-22击落了一个在美国阿拉斯加上空飞行的尚未确定身份的物体。
raw: The US military on Friday afternoon (February 10) fired its most advanced stealth jet, the F-22, to down an unidentified object in flight over Alaska.

src: 击落的地点距离阿拉斯加海岸十英里。
raw: The strike was ten miles from Alaska's coast.

src: 这是美军在不到一周的时间里第二次击落空中飞行物体。
raw: This is the second time in less than a week that US forces have downed an aerial target.

src: 上周六，来自中国的一个间谍气球在美国领空上漂移数日后在美国南卡罗莱纳州沿岸附近上空被击毁。
raw: An espionage balloon from China was shot down over South Carolina near the coast of North Carolina after drifting in US airspace for several days last Saturday.

src: 五角大楼说，第二个被击落的物体于周四晚上首次进入美国领空，在阿拉斯加东北部上空移动时被美国军方跟踪，飞行高度为1.2万米（4万英尺），其大小与一辆小型汽车差不多，与先前被击落的那个中国间谍气球相比要小很多。
raw: The Pentagon said that the second object downed Thursday night first entered US airspace over Alaska’s northeast and was tracked by US military as it moved at an altitude of 12,000 meters (39,000 feet) in size about the same as a small car, much smaller than the earlier Chinese spy balloon downed.

src: 五角大楼还认为，目前没有迹象显示，这个物体是可操纵的。
raw: The Pentagon still believes that there is no evidence to suggest that this object can be controlled.

src: 白宫国家安全委员会战略沟通协调员约翰·科比周五表示，虽然这个在高空飞行的物体的具体样子尚不清楚，但它“对民航飞机的安全构成了合理的威胁”。
raw: US National Security Council spokesman John Kobie Friday said that while the object’s exact shape in midair was unclear, it “poses a reasonable threat to the safety of commercial aircraft.”

src: 科比表示，这个物体与美国境内发现的那个间谍气球不同，它上面没有悬挂“有效载荷”。
raw: Kobe said that this object is different from the spy balloon discovered in the United States, which does not have an attached payload.

src: 科比说，“我们把它称为一个‘物体’是我们目前能够作出的最好的描述”。
raw: Kobe says that “calling it an object is our best description currently.”

src: 拜登总统在下令击落这个物体之前听取了五角大楼的建议，他作出这个决定的时候“非常谨慎”，科比补充说。
raw: President Biden listened to Pentagon advice before ordering its destruction and said he made his decision “very carefully.”

raw: Xinhua News Agency Beijing February 10, 2023 General Secretary of the Communist Party of China, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission Xi Jinping wrote back to the medical team members sent for aid in Central African Republic (CAR) on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, expressing greetings and putting forward earnest expectations.

src: 习近平在回信中说，你们在中非克服工作生活上的困难，用心服务当地民众，既是救死扶伤的白衣天使，也是传递情谊的友好使者。

src: 今年是中国援外医疗队派遣60周年，谨向正在和曾经执行援外医疗任务的同志们致以诚挚的慰问。
raw: This year marks the 60th anniversary of China’s dispatching medical teams abroad; I extend sincere greetings to all comrades who have and continue to serve in international medical missions.

src: 习近平指出，中国人民热爱和平、珍视生命，援外医疗就是生动的体现。

src: 希望你们不忘初心、牢记使命，大力弘扬不畏艰苦、甘于奉献、救死扶伤、大爱无疆的中国医疗队精神，以仁心仁术造福当地人民，以实际行动讲好中国故事，为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体作出更大贡献。
raw: I hope that you will always keep your初心and remember your mission, to vigorously carry forward the spirit of China's medical teams - not fearing hardship and content with selfless service, saving lives and helping others without regard for life and death, and caring for all humanity - so as to benefit local people with compassion and skill, and through concrete actions tell the story of China well, making greater contributions to building a community with a shared future for humankind.

src: 援外医疗是我国援外工作的重要内容。
raw: Foreign medical assistance is an important component of China's foreign aid work.

src: 1963年，我国向阿尔及利亚派出第一支援外医疗队。

src: 60年来，累计向非洲、亚洲、美洲、欧洲和大洋洲的76个国家和地区派遣医疗队员3万人次，诊治患者2.9亿人次，赢得国际社会广泛赞誉。

src: 目前，援外医疗队在全球56个国家的115个医疗点工作，其中近一半在偏远艰苦地区。
raw: Currently, the medical teams for overseas assistance work in 115 health posts in 56 countries, with nearly half of them located in remote and harsh regions.

src: 近日，第19批援中非中国医疗队的11名队员给习近平总书记写信，汇报学习贯彻党的二十大精神、为当地民众提供医疗服务等情况，表达为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体贡献力量的决心。

src: 伊朗官方纪念伊朗革命 44 周年，莱西的强硬派政府面临着要求他们下台的年轻抗议者提出的最大胆的挑战，但莱西仍然呼吁“受骗的青年”悔改，这样他们才能得到伊朗最高领导人的赦免。

src: 22 岁的阿米尼 Mahsa Amini 于 9 月在该国道德警察的拘禁中死亡后，全国范围内的抗议活动席卷仍然在伊朗。
raw: After Mahsa Amini, 22, died in custody of Iran’s morality police on September 16, nationwide protests erupted across the country, still in Iran.

src: 伊朗安全部队对抗议活动进行致命镇压，这是伊斯兰共和国自 1979 年革命推翻 2500 年君主制以来面临的最强大挑战之一。
raw: The Iranian security forces have ruthlessly suppressed protests, making this one of the most powerful challenges to Islamic Republic since the overthrow of the monarchy in 1979.

src: 作为纪念革命周年大赦的一部分，伊朗当局于周五释放了绝食抗议的被监禁的持不同政见者法哈德·梅萨米和伊朗-法国学者法里巴·阿德尔哈。

src: 中国愿同日方一道，继续深化绿色低碳产业合作、技术合作、政策对话和人文交流，推动两国绿色发展合作不断迈上新台阶。

raw: Q&A on Double Ninth Festival | How to Interpret the Unexpectedly Strong Non-Farm Payrolls Data in January and Its Future Trends - Economic Observer - A Professional Financial News Website

src: Q：请问重阳投资，如何看待美国1月非农就业数据大超预期及未来趋势？
raw: Q: How do you view the unexpectedly strong January non-farm employment data from the US and its future trends?

src: A：2月3日美国劳工部公布2023年1月非农就业数据，新增非农就业51.7万人，大幅高于市场预期的18.9万人；失业率降至3.4%，为近50年以来的最低位；时薪同比增速4.4%，环比增速0.3%，略有放缓。
raw: A: On February 3rd, the US Labor Department released its January non-farm payroll data for 2023, with an increase of 5.17 million new jobs, significantly higher than market expectations of 1.89 million; unemployment rate fell to 3.4%, marking the lowest level in nearly five decades; hourly wage growth was up 4.4% year-over-year and 0.3% month-over-month, showing some moderation.

src: 从总量上来看，本次数据存在很多一次性和技术性因素的扰动，比如罢工返岗的教职工、调查统计口径的修正、季调因子的更新，后续可能将有所修正（参考2022年1月新增非农由50.4万人下修至36.4万人），非农就业或不像数据体现的那样强劲。
raw: From a total perspective, this data is subject to many one-off and technical factors of disturbance, such as teachers returning from strike, adjustments in survey statistics, updates on seasonal adjustment factors, etc., which may be revised (refer to the downward revision of non-farm payroll employment for January 2022 from 5.04 million to 3.64 million). Non-farm payroll employment may not be as strong as it appears in the data.

src: 从结构上来看，高科技企业裁员影响仍在，但占比较低；高接触性服务业如休闲酒店、教育保健等新增就业大幅回升，数据显示服务业劳动力缺口仍存。
raw: From an organizational perspective, high-tech layoffs continue to have an impact, albeit at lower rates; but sectors with high contact levels such as leisure hotels and education/healthcare saw significant increases in new employment, indicating that there is still a labor shortage in services.

src: 结合同样大超预期的服务业PMI、岗位空缺和劳动力缺口数据的回升和消费信贷数据的强势，我们判断经过极端天气和节假日后美国服务业迎来了快速修复。
raw: The rebound in services PMI and job vacancies/labor shortages data, combined with strong consumer credit data, suggests that US services have quickly recovered after extreme weather and holidays.

src: 我们认为，在不经过衰退的情况下美国就业市场的供需紧张难以改善。
raw: We believe that improving US labor market tightness without a recession is unlikely.

src: 目前美国劳动力市场尚有500余万的供给缺口，而劳动参与率上行缓慢，尤其是25-54岁劳动参与率已经接近疫情前高点。
raw: Currently, there is still a supply gap of over 5 million in US labor markets, with labor participation rates rising slowly, especially among those aged 25 to 54 who have already reached their pre-pandemic peak.

src: 除此之外，由于美国居民超额储蓄和消费信贷的强势，消费需求的强劲将促使紧缩政策对就业市场的影响进一步滞后。
raw: Moreover, because of strong excess saving and consumption credit among US residents, the strength of consumer demand will further delay the impact on employment markets from tightening policies.

src: 美国就业市场供需持续紧张将是2023年美国经济的底色。
raw: A tight labor market in the US will be the bedrock of 2023 US economic performance.

src: 叠加目前临近加息结束，通胀预期不断反复，我们对薪资增速的持续下降并不乐观。
raw: Adding to the near-end of the tightening cycle and with inflation expectations constantly fluctuating, we do not expect sustained declines in wage growth.

src: 本次数据公布前，美国股债汇市场对于美联储加息路径的预期过于乐观。
raw: Expectations for an overly optimistic path for US Fed rate hikes were already high before today’s data release.

src: 随着通胀数据的持续改善，美联储在缩短加息步伐的同时还不断维系着市场通胀预期脆弱的平衡，但市场对于美联储偏向鹰派的表述视而不见，不仅预期提前停止加息，还预期年末两次降息。
raw: With inflation data improving, the Fed is shortening its tightening pace while maintaining market expectations of an unstable balance between hawkishness and dovishness. But markets ignore the Fed’s hawkish tone, expecting it to cut rates twice at year-end instead of just once.

src: 在劳动力市场供需紧张，紧缩政策影响不明的情况下，我们认为美联储年末对于加息的指引是相对合理的，市场极端预期的调整和交易的拥挤或将对市场产生一定伤害。
raw: In an environment of labor market tightness and unclear tightening policy impact, we believe that the Fed’s guidance for an end-of-year rate hike is reasonable; extreme expectations in the market and crowded trading may cause some harm to the market.

src: 尽管如此，薪资增速的顽固难改当前通胀快速下降的趋势，随着M2数据同比转负以及各个CPI分项领先指标的逐渐转好，自10月份以来美国CPI数据已经转向快速下降阶段，薪资增速的顽固仅会对以后的通胀数据形成托底，当前的市场预期难以证伪，在下一期通胀数据公布后市场或进入新一轮博弈。
raw: While this is not the case, stubborn wage growth has continued to impede the rapid decline in inflation that was observed recently. As M2 data turns negative and leading indicators of various CPI components gradually improve, US CPI data have turned towards a quick decline phase since October. Wage growth’s stubbornness will only provide support for future inflation data; current market expectations cannot be refuted. In the next round of inflation data releases, the market may enter another round of speculation.

src: 深圳：打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市-中新网
raw: Shenzhen: A Leading and World-Class Fast-Paced Pioneer City - China News Service

src: 中新网2月11日电 据“深圳工信”微信公众号10日消息，深圳市工业和信息化局近日印发《深圳市极速先锋城市建设行动计划》。
raw: Xinhua News Agency reported on February 11th that the Shenzhen Industrial and Information Technology Bureau has recently issued the “Action Plan for Building an Ultra-fast Pioneer City of Shenzhen”.

src: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
raw: It is proposed that by the end of 2023, a super broadband network with high rates, large capacity, and low latency will be built to achieve the goal of “Dual Gigabit, Full Optical Network, 1 millisecond, Everything Connected,” making it China’s first and world-leading city in terms of ultra-fast speed.

src: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
raw: The plan calls for accelerating the upgrade of the gigabit optical network.

src: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
raw: By the end of 2023, 10G PON ports will account for 100% and there will be over 100 all-optical industrial parks (industrial parks).

src: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
raw: The plan calls for an overall improvement in 5G network efficiency.

src: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
raw: Developing quality specifications and standards for 5G network services in Shenzhen, conducting tests and evaluations of 5G networks, and enhancing their service quality.

src: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
raw: Supporting basic telecommunications operators to enhance 5G network optimization in key areas and venues nationwide, with an additional 10,000 new base stations added this year, achieving an average download speed of 500 Mbps and an upload speed of 100 Mbps across the city, as well as speeds of 1 Gbps for key areas and 200 Mbps for uploads; network speeds and user experience have significantly improved.

src: 打造城市级高品质无线局域网。
raw: Build a city-level high-quality wireless local area network.

src: 制定公共场所无线局域网(WLAN)服务规范，推动全市各区人员密集和信息消费需求集中区域WLAN升级，提供千兆接入能力。
raw: Develop WLAN service standards for public places and promote upgrades in WLANs in densely populated and information-hungry areas across all districts to provide gigabit access capabilities.

src: 依托“深i网”建设全市公共无线局域网统一认证监管平台，实现“一次认证、无感漫游、智能切换”，支持运营主体将具有公共服务能力的社会自建AP(无线接入点)纳入认证监管平台。
raw: Based on “Deep iNet”, a unified authentication and supervision platform for public wireless local area networks across the city is being constructed to achieve one-time authentication with seamless roaming and intelligent switching, supporting operators to integrate social self-built APs (wireless access points) with the authentication supervision platform.

src: 2023年底前，升级接入AP总量不少于2万个。
raw: By the end of 2023, we will upgrade and connect to at least 20,000 APs.

src: 此外，《计划》还提出，建设高品质全光运力网络、构建多层次算力供给体系、加快关键通信网络设施建设、提升互联网应用服务能力。
raw: In addition, the plan calls for building high-quality optical transport networks with full spectrum capabilities; constructing multi-level computing resource supply systems; accelerating key communication network construction; and enhancing internet application service levels.

src: 《计划》明确，协同构建物联感知体系。
raw: The plan clearly states that collaborative construction of an IoT perception system will be carried out.

src: 探索以“开源鸿蒙”操作系统为基础，构建城市感知终端建设管理模式，降低对接成本，加快建设城市级物联感知平台，推动市区物联网平台、各领域专业物联网平台网络与数据互联互通。
raw: Explore building management models for urban perception terminal construction based on the “open-source HarmonyOS” operating system to lower integration costs and accelerate the development of city-level IoT perception platforms. Promote interconnectivity and data interoperability among various municipal IoT platform networks and professional IoT platform networks.

src: 深化物联感知在城市管理、民生服务、公共安全、交通出行等领域应用，拓展城市道路、建筑、公共设施等固定感知与智能网联汽车等移动感知采集渠道。
raw: Deepen application of IoT perception in urban management, public services, public safety, and traffic travel, expand fixed sensing channels such as city roads, buildings, and public facilities, and mobile sensing channels such as intelligent connected vehicles.

src: 2023年底前，水电气物联网感知终端数量超过900万，打造20个多功能智能杆应用示范项目。
raw: By the end of 2023, more than 9 million water, electricity, and gas IoT sensing terminals will be deployed, with the aim to launch 20 demonstration projects for multi-functional smart poles.

src: 《计划》还提到，加强卫星与地面通信融合应用、布局低空网络基础设施建设、推进海上5G网络深度覆盖。
raw: The plan also noted that efforts will be made to strengthen satellite-ground communication integration applications, lay out low-altitude network infrastructure construction, and promote deep coverage of 5G networks at sea.

src: 同时，推进海上5G网络深度覆盖、构建产业创新发展生态、支持举办顶级赛事和活动。
raw: At the same time, we will advance 5G network deep coverage at sea, build an innovation ecosystem for industry development, and support hosting top-level events and activities.

src: 中国电商行业涌现“新变量”，带货如何做到“内容为王”？
raw: China’s e-commerce industry is witnessing “new variables,” how to achieve “content supremacy”?

src: -中新网
raw: China News Service

src: 中新网2月11日电 题：中国电商行业涌现“新变量”，带货如何做到“内容为王”？
raw: China News Service, February 11th: New Variables in China's E-commerce Industry - How to Achieve "Content Dominance" in Douyin?

src: 中新财经记者 夏宾
raw: Xia Bin, a reporter from China Finance News

src: “我们入局电商算是晚的，但从最开始就意识到，想要从千千万万的店铺中脱颖而出，内容很重要。
raw: We entered the e-commerce game late, but from the start we realized that standing out among millions of shops is important, and content plays a big role.

src: ”来自广东的“90后”女生芳芳，现在在抖音电商运营一家滋补食材店铺，让一家有着30多年历史的线下店在线上“开花”。
raw: Fangfang, an 90s girl from Guangdong who runs a health food store on Douyin e-commerce, has made her offline business that has been around for over three decades blossom online.

src: 模仿老港片影调、配上经典粤语歌，打开@芳芳一人食抖音账号，精美的视频令人耳目一新。
raw: Imitating the old Hong Kong film look and adding classic Cantonese songs, click on @Fangfang's One-Dish Wok account to see stunning videos that will leave you breathless.

src: 在近日举行的抖音电商“寻找同行者·优质内容分享专场”上，芳芳作为优质创作者代表到场发言，介绍了日常创作的经历和体会。
raw: At the recent Douyin E-commerce “Find Your Peers · Showcase of High-Quality Content Sharing” event, Fangfang, as an example of a high-quality creator, gave a speech on her daily creative experiences and insights.

src: 她在现场说：“精心打磨的视频收获了很多网友的关注，好多人对我家的食材感兴趣，想跟着一起做美食，销路就一下子打开了。
raw: She said on stage: "The carefully polished video has attracted much attention from netizens, and many people are interested in my family's ingredients, wanting to make their own food together; sales have opened up immediately."
English: "Translation requested."

src: 芳芳靠着煲汤视频让更多人爱上“老广的味道”，一场直播最多卖出30万件滋补食材，挽救了家里濒临倒闭的老店。
raw: Fang Fang’s video of making soups has helped more people fall in love with “Guangdong flavors,” and one livestream sold as many as 300, 000 pieces of tonics for her family-run store that was on the verge of closing down.

src: “无内容，不电商”，随着短视频和直播电商不断发展，人们对电商内容的要求和标准正步入新阶段。
raw: "Without content, no e-commerce," as video and live-streaming-based e-commerce continues to develop, people's expectations for and standards of online shopping have entered a new phase.

src: 直播带货发展初期，直播间往往用低价折扣吸引用户，价格优势似乎成了当时的唯一卖点。
raw: In the early days of live-streaming e-commerce, price advantage was the sole selling point as sellers competed on low prices to attract buyers.

src: 近年来，既有刘畊宏、东方甄选等现象级大V，也有在垂直细分领域出现的不少非大众所知的达人和商家，他们通过持续打造符合自己品牌调性的优质内容，提升长期经营效益。
raw: In recent years, there have been both phenomenon-level influencers like Lao Jiong Hong and Dongfang Zhenxuan, as well as many non-lauded experts and merchants in niche vertical fields who have emerged, leveraging their ability to consistently create high-quality content that aligns with their brand’s unique style to enhance long-term business benefits.

src: 抖音电商明星作者运营负责人高亚轩介绍，过去一年有627万创作者通过抖音电商将内容变现，他们的内容创作量增长了252%，总成交额也翻了一倍以上。
raw: Gao Yaxuan from Douyin E-commerce Content Creator Operations said that in the past year, 6.27 million creators have monetized their content through Douyin E-commerce, with their creation volume increasing by over 250% and total transaction value rising more than twice.

src: “在这些数字背后，我们能感受到一个蓬勃生长、具有旺盛生命力的作者生态。
raw: Behind these numbers lies an author ecosystem that is burgeoning and full of vitality.

src: ”高亚轩说。
raw: "High Sky轩 said."

src: 北京师范大学传播创新与未来媒体实验平台此前发布了《电商行业内容生态健康指数(ECHI)报告》，从数据维度解析了当前电商行业中“新变量”——优质内容的重要性，运用指数对国内27家主流电商平台内容生态情况进行了评估。
raw: The Beijing Normal University Platform for Innovation in Communication and Future Media previously released the ECHI Report on the Content Ecological Health Index of the E-commerce Industry, which analyzed the importance of high-quality content from a data perspective, assessing the content ecological status of 27 major e-commerce platforms domestically using an index system.

src: 根据上述报告的电商行业内容生态健康指数排名，抖音电商、快手、淘宝、拼多多、京东位居前五。
raw: According to the report on e-commerce industry content ecosystem health index rankings, Douyin E-commerce, Kuaishou, Tmall, Pinduoduo, and JD rank among the top five.

src: 报告认为，电商行业内容生态是一个综合性概念，是将电商与内容进行整合，但并非所有内容都可与电商整合，好的PGC(专业生产内容)与UGC(用户原创内容)才是与电商进行整合的优质载体，内容平台价值越高，消费与推广的场景也就越来越丰富，电商植入的可能性也就越高，商业价值也就越强，这种公共领域和私人领域逐步集成分布的电商内容生产和内容消费的比例也就会越高。
raw: The report argues that e-commerce content ecology is a comprehensive concept and involves integrating e-commerce with content but not all content can be integrated with e-commerce. High-quality PGC (professional production content) and UGC (user-generated content) are better carriers for integration with e-commerce than other types of content. The higher the value of the content platform, the more diverse consumption and promotion scenarios will become, making it easier to integrate e-commerce, increasing its commercial value, and this ratio of e-commerce content production and consumption in public and private domains will also increase accordingly.

src: 现场，北京师范大学新闻传播学院教授、中国传媒经济与管理专业委员会理事长喻国明对《报告》做了分析解读。
raw: On-site, Professor Yu Guoming of Beijing Normal University’s School of Journalism and Communication, who is also chairman of the China Media Economics and Management Professional Committee, provided an analysis and interpretation of the report.

src: 他表示，就内容价值而言，当前电商行业已经从“消费可及性”过渡到“消费品质化”阶段，优质、专业、差异化的内容是电商行业的“硬通货”。
raw: He said that in terms of content value, the current e-commerce industry has transitioned from “accessibility to consumption” to “quality-oriented consumption,” and high-quality, professional, and differentiated content is the “hard currency” of the e-commerce industry.

src: 同时，内容成为电商发展新阶段的根本和抓手，知识付费、专业性知识、KOL(关键意见领袖)等PGC内容开始在电商直播中成为标配。
raw: At the same time, content has become the new stage of e-commerce development and its fundamental and lever, with PGC (Professional Content Generator) content such as knowledge payment, specialized knowledge, and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) becoming standard features in live-streaming on e-commerce platforms.

src: 展望电商行业的未来发展，喻国明提出两方面的建议。
raw: Looking to the future of e-commerce, Yu Guoming proposes two suggestions.

src: 一个是从内容结构提升的角度看，推动电商内容生态健康程度和质量整体提升，打造正向内容创作和管理标准，实现电商行业内容生态健康系统指数与动态均衡。
raw: One is to improve content structure from an angle of promoting the overall health and quality improvement of the e-commerce content ecosystem, establishing positive standards for content creation and management, and achieving dynamic equilibrium in the index of the healthy system of the e-commerce industry's content ecosystem.

src: 另一个是从外部生态看，要实现内容电商行业的健康发展和外部环境的价值协同与共创。
raw: Another is to look at it from an external ecosystem perspective and achieve healthy development of content e-commerce and value collaboration and creation with the external environment.

src: “未来电商行业还需要更多的数据、人工智能方面的支持，形成对未来发展稳定性的预测；此外，为商家提供更规范、健康的成长空间，实现电商行业中企业、用户、产品与服务的价值协同，共创健康内容生态。
raw: "More data and support from artificial intelligence will be needed in the future e-commerce industry to predict stability for its development; moreover, it is essential to provide more standardized and healthy growth spaces for merchants so that enterprises, users, products, and services can achieve value synergy within an eco-system of healthy content."

src: （德国之声中文网）拜登政府本周五（2月10日）将6个与疑似参与间谍气球计划的中国实体列入黑名单。
raw: The US administration will blacklist six Chinese entities suspected of being involved in the spy balloon program this Friday (February 10).

src: 美国商务部表示，这5家中国公司及1家研究机构帮助中国军队现代化，尤其是航空航天项目，包括飞艇和飞机。
raw: The US Department of Commerce said that these five Chinese companies and one research institute helped modernize China’s armed forces, especially in aerospace projects such as blimps and aircraft.

src: 被列入黑名单的公司很难获得美国的技术出口。
raw: Companies on the blacklist have difficulty obtaining US technology exports.

src: 名单被称为“实体名单”（entity list），入列的公司除非获得美国商务部的特别出口许可证，否则将无法向美国供应商购买技术或商品。
raw: The list is called an “entity list,” and companies that enter it will be unable to purchase technology or goods from US suppliers unless they obtain a special export license from the US Department of Commerce.

src: 被列入黑名单的公司是：北京南江空天科技股份有限公司、中国电子科技集团第四十八研究所、东莞凌空遥感科技有限公司、鹰门航空科技集团有限公司、广州天海翔航空科技有限公司和山西鹰门航空科技集团有限公司。
raw: The companies listed on the blacklist are: Beijing Nanjiang Sky Space Technology Co., Ltd., China Electronics Science and Technology Group Fourth Eighth Research Institute, Dongguan Lingkong Remote Sensing Technology Co., Ltd., Eagle Gate Aviation Technology Group Co., Ltd., Guangzhou Tianhai Xiang Aeronautical Technology Co., Ltd., and Shanxi Eagle Gate Aviation Technology Group Co., Ltd.

src: 在此之前，白宫表示考虑做出更广泛措施，“揭露和处理”中国威胁美国国家安全的更大规模监控活动。
raw: Prior to this, the White House had indicated it was considering broader measures “to expose and address” larger-scale surveillance activities that threaten American national security by China.

src: 气球事件引发中美之间进一步紧张，美国国务卿布林肯取消了访问中国的行程。
raw: The Balloons Incident has further strained relations between China and the US, with Secretary of State Blinken cancelling his visit to Beijing.

src: 美国2月4日击落气球，中国政府向美国驻华使馆提出严正交涉，批评美国严重冲击和损害双方稳定中美关系的努力和进程。
raw: On February 4, the US shot down an air balloon, and China raised a serious protest to the US embassy in Beijing over America’s severe interference and damage to both sides’ efforts and progress toward stabilizing Sino-US relations.

src: 从现有残骸证据及中国军方的采购平台资讯，美国政府得出结论，认为该气球的制造厂商“跟中国解放军有直接关系”，而且是中国军方批准的供应商。
raw: Based on existing debris evidence and information from China’s military procurement platform, the US government concluded that the manufacturer of the balloon “is directly related to the People's Liberation Army,” and was approved as a supplier by the Chinese military.

src: 中国外交部发言人毛宁在周五的新闻发布会上表示，关于一只中国无人民用飞艇因不可抗力误入美国领空的意外事件，中方已经多次说明情况、阐明立场。
raw: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Ma Ning said on Friday that China has repeatedly explained and clarified its position regarding an incident where a Chinese unmanned airship without people accidentally entered US airspace due to force majeure.

src: 根据外交部网站，她补充表示，美国国会的有关决议案纯属政治操弄和炒作。
raw: According to the Foreign Ministry website, she added that US Congress resolutions are pure political maneuvering and hype.

src: 中方对此强烈不满、坚决反对。
raw: China is strongly dissatisfied and resolutely opposes this.

src: 美国商务部负责出口执法的助理部长阿克塞尔罗德(Matthew Axelrod)表示： “今天的行动表明，我们查明并阻止中国使用间谍气球而做出的共同努力，这些气球侵犯了美国和40多个国家的领空。
raw: Axelrod, an Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Export Enforcement at the US Department of Commerce, said that "Today's action demonstrates our efforts to identify and prevent China from using spy balloons, which have violated airspace over 40 countries including the United States."
English: "Translation requested."

src: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
raw: The Singapore tourism market gradually reopens and recovers in 2022.

src: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
raw: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that inbound tourists in 2022 grew 19-fold from 330, 000 in 2021 to 6. 3 million, surpassing the earlier forecast of 40-60 million. The number of visitors has recovered to 33% of pre-pandemic levels.

src: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
raw: Tourism revenue in Singapore for January to September 2022 was S$8.96 billion, and it is expected that tourism revenue for the full year of 2022 will be between S$13.8 billion and S$14.3 billion, up sixfold to sevenfold from S$1.89 billion in 2021, which has already recovered to around 50% to 52% of pre-COVID-19 levels.

src: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
raw: The Singapore government is taking multiple measures to accelerate tourism recovery.

src: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
raw: In April 2022, the government announced that it would allocate around $490 million to stimulate tourism recovery.

src: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
raw: The Tourism Board announced yesterday that it plans to allocate S$100 million from this budget over the next two years for more commercial and leisure activities aimed at attracting tourists back.

src: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
raw: To make wellness tourism an important highlight of Singapore’s tourism offerings, the Singapore Tourism Board launched an intention solicitation on November 23, 2022, with plans to develop a wellness destination in the southern coast of Singapore.

src: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
raw: Singapore Tourism Board’s Sports and Wellness Tourism Division Director Wang Lingli said that in recent years, more tourists have placed health at the forefront of all considerations.

src: 在拥有滨海湾花园、滨海堤坝的滨海南区开发一个健康养生景点，有望为新加坡的旅游业和经济作出贡献，让游客在新加坡消费并逗留更久。
raw: Developing a health and wellness attraction in the South Beach area, with its Marina Bay Sands and Marina Barrages, has the potential to contribute to Singapore’s tourism and economy, encouraging visitors to spend more time there.

src: 新加坡旅游局局长陈建隆表示，未来几年内，健康养生将成为新加坡旅游产品的重要组成部分。
raw: Tourism局局长 Chan Jianlong said that in the coming years, health and wellness will become an important component of Singapore’s tourism products.

src: 新冠疫情提升了公众对于身体和心理健康的认知和需求。
raw: The pandemic has raised public awareness and demand for physical and mental health.

src: 为此，过去两年旅游局一直向本地公众和国际游客推广健康养生项目。
raw: In this regard, in the past two years, the tourism bureau has been promoting health and wellness programs for local residents and international tourists.

src: 2022年6月，新加坡旅游局举办了首届健康养生节，为公众提供了130多项各类健康活动和体验。
raw: In June 2022, Singapore Tourism Board held its first Wellness Festival, offering over 130 health-related activities and experiences to the public.

src: 新加坡将持续为游客提供新的旅行体验。
raw: Singapore will continue to offer new travel experiences for tourists.

src: 除新开放的新加坡儿童博物馆、滨海湾花园的阿凡达世界、圣淘沙中央海滩市集、艺术科学博物馆新增的“探索新领域”展厅，以及夜间野生动物园新建的露天剧场外，旅游局将支持万态野生动物世界的飞禽公园等项目发展与更新，使新加坡成为具有吸引力的国际旅行地。
raw: In addition to new attractions such as Singapore’s Children’s Museum, Avatar World at Sentosa Bay Gardens, Central Beach Market in Sentosa, and the newly opened outdoor theatre of Night Safari, the Tourism Board will support development and updates for projects like the aviary park at Wild Safari, making Singapore an attractive destination for international travel.

src: 按照计划，新加坡将于2023年年内制定会议、会展与奖励旅游业可持续发展的相关行业标准，并着重改善废物处理和碳排放两大方面的问题，进一步优化旅游环境。
raw: According to the plan, Singapore will develop industry standards for sustainable development of meetings, exhibitions and incentive tourism in 2023, with particular focus on waste management and carbon emissions reduction issues, further optimizing the travel environment.

src: 新加坡旅游业的复苏加快了航空业复苏。
raw: Tourism in Singapore is fueling an upturn in aviation.

src: 数据显示，截至2022年12月18日，樟宜机场客流量强劲复苏，每天接待的乘客已多达15万人次，每周约100万人次，相当于新冠疫情前的75%左右，航空业员工在岗数量也已经恢复到疫情前约90%的水平。
raw: Data shows that as of December 18, 2022, Changi Airport has seen a strong recovery in passenger traffic, with daily passengers reaching over 150,000 and weekly numbers around 1 million, equivalent to about 75% of pre-pandemic levels, and the number of employees back at work is also up to approximately 90% of their pre-pandemic level.

src: 数据显示，2022年1月至10月新加坡已接待旅客2360万人次，相当于新冠疫情前的42%，起降航班17万架次，是疫情前的53%。
raw: Data show that in January to October 2022, Singapore welcomed 23.6 million visitors, equivalent to 42% of pre-pandemic levels and 53% of pre-pandemic air traffic volumes.

src: 旅游业快速复苏，也带动了住宿、交通、餐饮和购物等行业的复苏步伐。
raw: Tourism’s rapid rebound has also spurred recovery in sectors such as accommodation, transportation, dining, and shopping.

src: 新加坡政府和旅游业对中国市场寄予厚望。
raw: The Singapore government and tourism industry have high hopes for China market.

src: 新加坡旅游局国际司助理局长柯淑丹说，中国旅行平台的一项调查显示，新加坡的安全指数位列全球前三，这也是新加坡深受中国游客喜爱的原因之一。
raw: Tourism Board’s Assistant Director for International Affairs Koh Shudan said that a survey of China travel platforms revealed Singapore’s safety index to be among the top three globally, which is also one reason why Singapore enjoys popularity with Chinese tourists.

src: 新冠疫情前，中国每年有约360万人次到新加坡旅行度假。
raw: Before the pandemic, China welcomed about 3 million visitors to Singapore for travel and tourism every year.

src: 随着中国放宽边境政策，预计今年中国游客人次可恢复至2019年的三成至六成。
raw: With China easing border policies, it is expected that this year’s number of inbound tourists will recover to 30-60% of the level in 2019.

src: 柯淑丹指出，接下来，旅游局将密切关注中国针对出境旅行政策进一步释放的信号，以应对游客需求的变化。
raw: Ko Shudan noted that the Tourism Bureau will closely monitor signals from China on further liberalization of outbound tourism policies to respond to changes in tourist demand.

src: 新加坡旅游局除与携程等中国线上旅行平台、旅行社强化伙伴关系外，将针对中国境外游出现的新趋势，积极做好接待中国游客的准备。
raw: The Singapore Tourism Board will also make preparations to welcome Chinese tourists who visit from overseas in response to new trends emerging in China’s outbound tourism market.

src: 展望2023年旅游市场，新加坡旅游局充满信心，认为全球经济只要不出现显著衰退影响公众收入，以及不再有新的大面积致命疫情暴发等情况出现，旅游业复苏步伐将快于预期。
raw: Looking ahead to 2023, Singapore Tourism Board is optimistic about the tourism market, believing that as long as global economic conditions do not experience significant downturns and there are no new large-scale outbreaks of deadly pandemics, the pace of tourism recovery will be faster than expected.

Not only were there off-key notes, but also poor bass quality compared to what I had heard before. There were some additional noises, is it possible that only my purple headphones have this issue? Or could it be that the headphone manufacturing process has indeed fallen short?

src: 相当差的评价，很失望。
raw: Terrible feedback; very disappointed.

src: 明天白天一定要退货。
raw: Make sure to return it tomorrow during the day.

src: PS颜值不错
raw: PS looks good.

src: 亚马逊自营不应该出现这样商品
raw: Amazon's own should not be selling such products.

src: 产品特价的时候购买，价格不低，看评论也是很不错的产品。
raw: Buy during sales; not cheap; good reviews.

src: 实际收到产品的时候让我目瞪口呆，商品表面大面积磨损，多处其他地方都有磨损，不是次品就是旧品，稍后上图。
raw: When I received the product, it left me speechless; there was extensive wear and tear on the surface, as well as damage in other areas – not a defective item but an old one, or at least second-hand. Please see the attached image for details.

src: 我申请退货，厂家的人看到图片后说是运输导致，这不是瞎说吗？
raw: I am applying for a return; the manufacturer's people say it was caused by transportation, is this not nonsense?

src: 商品内部怎么可能磨损？
raw: How can something be worn out within a product?

src: 只有两种可能，要么次品旧品，要么就是我故意损坏商品，然后拿去退货。
raw: There are only two possibilities: either defective or old goods; or I deliberately damaged the product and returned it.

src: 客观来讲，我没有证据证明我没有损坏商品，但是以我在亚马逊购物的信用记录来讲，我认为这样的商品不应该出现在亚马逊自营商品中，客户选择亚马逊自营就是信任，customer win，we win，客户的胜利就是厂商的胜利，希望大家一起努力改进，谢谢。
raw: In objective terms, I do not have evidence to prove that I did not damage the product, but based on my credit record for shopping on Amazon, I believe such products should not be included in Amazon's own goods; customer choice is trust, and we all win. Customer victory is also the victory of the manufacturer. Let us work together to improve this situation, thank you.

src: 很满意的手表
raw: Very satisfied with the watch.

src: 肯定是正品，去专柜验过货，表的外观很漂亮，做工精细，用料足，加上又是进口机械机芯，所以是有一定的分量的，是那些三四百所谓的机械表不能比的，这个是货真价实的。
raw: It is definitely genuine; I have checked it at the boutique and the watch looks very nice in appearance with fine workmanship. The materials used are sufficient, and as it has an imported mechanical movement, it carries some weight. It cannot be compared to those so-called mechanical watches priced around 300 yuan. This is authentic merchandise.

src: 表的走时是很准的，误差完全在可接受范围内，表的包装里有珠宝鉴定证书，表盘的12字那里是真钻石，这个自己戴很合适，作为礼品送出去也很有面子。
raw: The watch is accurate and within acceptable error limits; it comes with a jewelry appraisal certificate inside the box, and the 12-word mark on the dial is genuine diamond. It fits well for personal use, and as a gift, it adds to one's prestige.

src: 宾利表确实不错。
raw: Bentley is indeed good.

src: 东西不错
raw: It's good on both sides.

src: 东西着实不错，送女友的，只是中午我不在加拿快递的时候有些不愉快，物流公司直接放邮件寄存宝里并且没发取件的验证短信给我，害我跑了两趟。
raw: It was quite good on both sides, but I had some unpleasantness with the courier when I wasn't in Canada to send it during lunchtime. The company simply put the mail in the locker without sending me an SMS for verification of pickup, which caused me to run twice.

src: 不过宝贝确实不错。
raw: But the item is indeed good.

src: 正品哟 包装好
raw: Authentic! Packaging is perfect.

src: 包装很完整，里面加了充气袋，没有网上评论的只有光秃秃一个产品的样子。
raw: The packaging is complete; an inflatable bag was added inside, and there's nothing but a product with no online reviews.

src: 瓶子外包装上还有一层塑料膜像图片上描述的一样，快递也很快，拍下第二天就来了。
raw: There was also an outer plastic film on the bottle that matched what is described in the picture, and it arrived quickly after I took a photo.

src: 是正品，只是没货了，不知道什么时候再上架。
raw: It's genuine; just out of stock at the moment and not sure when it will be back in stock.

src: 看起来很美好
raw: It looks very good.

src: 很久以前就看中这个摄像头了，但是因为除了价格外，还有一些别的原因，所以没有购买，这次因为凑包邮，价格也还可以所以就买了。
raw: I had long been eyeing this camera, but for reasons other than price, I didn't buy it before. This time, because of the package discount, the price was still acceptable, so I bought it.

src: 买来之后其他的都没什么问题，就是在软件连接的时候，怎么都连不上，我家是TP的路由器，上网查了之后发现好多人都有这个问题，弄了两个多小时，各种改路由器的设置，最后我用360WIFI作为媒介给弄好的，期间给小米客服打电话，他们对这个问题也没有什么解决方法，直接就让我联系亚马逊进行售后。
raw: After buying it, everything else was fine except for connecting to software, which wouldn't work; I had to connect through 360WiFi and call Xiaomi customer service, but they couldn't solve the problem either, so I had to contact Amazon for after-sales support.

src: 另外一点值得注意的就是我在网上看到用户的评论说，这个摄像头支持的存储卡最小是8G，存储容量更小的就不能识别，希望大家注意这点。
raw: Another point to note is that I have seen user comments online stating that this camera supports the smallest storage card of 8GB; any smaller and it will not be recognized, so please pay attention to this issue.

src: 用起来感觉还可以吧，画面还可以接受，但声音音质很差，机器有一定程度的发热，一直开启的话，感觉这种程度的发热有点让人难以接受。
raw: It feels good to use it, but the picture quality is still acceptable, but the audio quality is very poor. The machine has some degree of heat generation, and if you keep it on for a long time, it feels like this level of heat is somewhat difficult to accept.

src: 综上所述，本产品还有诸多不足，希望大家买的时候要慎重。
raw: In summary, this product has many shortcomings and I hope that you will buy it with caution.

src: 轻便大容量
raw: Light and large-capacity

src: 喜欢它轻便，开口大，就是两个独立的分隔袋对我来说有点多余，感觉不知道装什么好。
raw: I like it for its lightness and capacity but I find two separate compartments to be a bit excessive; I'm not sure what to put in them.

src: 买完发现海外购美亚上还有一只另一个牌子很类似的，才不到两百块。
raw: After buying it, I found that there was another brand similar one on Overseas Shopping (Meizu) for less than two hundred yuan.

raw: 4. Contact Amazon customer service separately and can only pay for shipping to the US and then make up the fee.

src: 5、2分的原因是客服服务还不错。
raw: 5. The reason for getting two stars is that customer service was good.

raw: The first time I bought something, it had problems; all the lights were flashing and not working.

raw: To request a refund, it took three days to get the goods to Shanghai and they still haven't been delivered.

src: 给配送的打电话也不接。
raw: Don't answer when called for delivery.

src: 快递公司说，他们只有那个联系方式。
raw: The courier company says they have that contact information only.

src: 亚马逊找不到投诉的地方。
raw: Amazon cannot find a place to lodge a complaint.

src: 没有要求过，延迟送货的情况下，莫名其妙按我的要求延迟送货－这样的短信过来。
raw: No request was ever made for delivery delays; I received an email saying that my requests were being ignored.

src: 后面又说什么中转问题。
raw: And what about transit issues?

src: 反正极差的购物体验，开始怀疑亚马逊的物流系统及控制系统的有效性。
raw: After all, the poor shopping experience has me questioning the effectiveness of Amazon's logistics and control systems.

src: 估计今天也拿不到。
raw: Estimate that he won't get it today either.
